```{r}
data_marketshare <- data.frame()
# filter to a needed dependent variable
data_marketshare <- appliances %>% 
                  filter(dep_variable_purchase_category == "market share of efficient appliance")

# exclude carroll, denny & lyons as they do not have a clear control 
# exclude houde & aldy (2017) as it is a peer-reviewed version of houde & aldy 2014
data_marketshare <- data_marketshare %>% 
                 filter(! study_ID %in% c("122","147"))

# exclude the outliers
#data_marketshare<- data_marketshare %>% 
 #                 filter(z_value > -0.5,
  #                       z_value < 0.5)
```

```{r}
data_marketshare$percent_change <- ifelse(is.na(data_marketshare$percent_change),
                                    data_marketshare$coefficient,
                                    data_marketshare$percent_change)

data_marketshare$percent_change <- data_marketshare$percent_change*100

# data_marketshare <- data_marketshare %>% filter(! study_ID %in% c("114","202"))

data_marketshare$percent_change_ci <-  ifelse(data_marketshare$study_ID == "114",
                                       data_marketshare$percent_change/abs(data_marketshare$t_stat),
                                       data_marketshare$coefficient_se*100)

data_marketshare <- data_marketshare %>% 
                  filter(percent_change > -30)
                   
data_marketshare <- data_marketshare %>% 
                  filter(percent_change < 30)

unique_studies_marketshare <- unique(data_marketshare$study_ID)
table(data_marketshare$appliance)
table(data_marketshare$intervention)
# 5 studies
# 27 obs
```

```{r}
# Count the occurrences
count <- table(data_marketshare$intervention)
print(count)

count <- table(data_marketshare$appliance)
print(count)

# Group by appliance and calculate summary statistics
summary_stats <- data_marketshare %>%
  group_by(appliance) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent_change = mean(percent_change),
    min_percent_change = min(percent_change),
    max_percent_change = max(percent_change),
    #mean_coefficient = mean(coefficient),
    #min_coefficient = min(coefficient),
    #max_coefficient = max(coefficient),
    #mean_tstat = mean(t_stat),
    mean_tstat_abs = mean(abs(t_stat))
  )

# Print the summary statistics
print(summary_stats)

# dishwasher - negative (Datta & Gulati)
# refrigerator - crazy tstat 
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)
library(RColorBrewer)

num_appliances <- length(unique(data_marketshare$appliance))
palette <- brewer.pal(num_appliances, "Set1")

intervention_colors <- setNames(palette, unique(data_marketshare$intervention))

### FOREST PLOTS ### 
data_marketshare$sr_no <- as.factor(data_marketshare$sr_no)
fp <- ggplot(data=data_marketshare, aes(x=sr_no, y=percent_change, ymin=percent_change - percent_change_ci, ymax=percent_change + percent_change_ci, colour = appliance)) +
        geom_pointrange(size=0.5) + 
        geom_hline(yintercept=1, lty=2) +  # add a dotted line at x=1 after flip
        coord_flip() +  # flip coordinates (puts labels on y axis)
        xlab("serial number") + ylab("mean percentage change") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = intervention_colors) +
        theme_bw()  + geom_label_repel(aes(label = paste0(round(percent_change, 2), "%")), size = 2, colour = "black", max.overlaps = 30)
print(fp)
ggsave("marketshare.png", plot = fp, width = 9.375, height = 9.375)
# group and label by author but keep in different rows
# try different graphs because with this one we really have to exclude a lot of outliers to zoom in 

### FREQUENCY TABLES AND DISTRIBUTIONS
ggplot(data_marketshare, aes(x = percent_change, y = percent_change_ci , colour = appliance)) +
  # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.05,.5))+
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.75) +
  #geom_jitter(width = .1, alpha = .25) +
  labs(x = "percent_change", y = "variance") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = appliance_colors) +
  facet_wrap(vars(data_marketshare$intervention))+ 
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
data_marketshare$sr_no <- as.factor(data_marketshare$sr_no)

fp <- ggplot(data = data_marketshare, aes(x = sr_no, y = percent_change, 
                                          ymin = percent_change - percent_change_ci, 
                                          ymax = percent_change + percent_change_ci, 
                                          colour = intervention)) +
        geom_pointrange(size = 0.5) + 
        geom_hline(yintercept = 1, lty = 2) +  # add a dotted line at y = 1 after flip
        coord_flip() +  # flip coordinates (puts labels on y axis)
        xlab("Serial Number") + ylab("Mean Percentage Change") +
        scale_colour_manual(values = intervention_colors) +
        theme_bw() +
        geom_label_repel(aes(label = paste0(round(percent_change, 2), "%")), 
                         size = 2, colour = "black", max.overlaps = 30) +
        facet_wrap(~ appliance, scales = "free_y")  # Facet by appliance to keep labels separate

print(fp)
ggsave("marketshare_appliance.png", plot = fp, width = 9.375, height = 9.375)
```

```{r}
data_marketshare$sr_no <- as.factor(data_marketshare$sr_no)
data_marketshare$study <- paste(data_marketshare$authors, " (", data_marketshare$year_publication, ")", sep = "")



fp <- ggplot(data = data_marketshare, aes(x = sr_no, y = percent_change, 
                                          ymin = percent_change - percent_change_ci, 
                                          ymax = percent_change + percent_change_ci, 
                                          colour = appliance)) +
        geom_pointrange(size = 0.5) + 
        geom_hline(yintercept = 1, lty = 2) +  # add a dotted line at y = 1 after flip
        coord_flip() +  # flip coordinates (puts labels on y axis)
        xlab("Serial Number") + ylab("Mean Percentage Change") +
        scale_colour_manual(values = appliance_colors) +
        theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(data_marketshare$study)) +
        geom_label_repel(aes(label = paste0(round(percent_change, 2), "%")), 
                         size = 2, colour = "black", max.overlaps = 30)
print(fp)
```




```{r}

# updated graph
fp <- ggplot(data = data_marketshare, aes(x = sr_no, y = percent_change, ymin = percent_change - percent_change_ci, ymax = percent_change + percent_change_ci, colour = appliance, shape = intervention)) +
  geom_pointrange(size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, lty = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  xlab("Serial Number") +
  ylab("Mean Percentage Change") +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = paste0(round(percent_change, 2), "%")), size = 3, colour = "black", max.overlaps = 15) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",  
        legend.justification = c(1, 0),
        legend.title = element_blank()) + theme(text = element_text(size = 17.5))  

print(fp)
ggsave("marketshare.png", plot = fp, width = 9.375, height = 9.375)
```

```{r}
#custom_order <- c("Label", "Rebate")
data_marketshare$intervention <- as.factor(data_marketshare$intervention)
#data_marketshare <- data_marketshare[order(match(data_marketshare$intervention, custom_order)), ]

data_marketshare$label <- ifelse(data_marketshare$intervention == "Label",1,0)

fp <- ggplot(data = data_marketshare, aes(x = reorder(study,label), y = percent_change, ymin = percent_change - percent_change_ci, ymax = percent_change + percent_change_ci, colour = appliance, shape = intervention)) +
  geom_pointrange(size = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  xlab("Authors") +
  ylab("Mean Percentage Change") +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = paste0(round(percent_change, 2), "%")), size = 6.5, colour = "black", max.overlaps = 5) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",  
        legend.justification = c(1, 0),
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 18)) + theme(text = element_text(size = 30))  

print(fp)
ggsave("marketshare.png", plot = fp, width = 15, height = 12, resolution = 1000)
```
